$comment: Curated shortlist for the profile. Stars, forks and language are pulled live from the GitHub API at build time — only the prose lives here.

projects.title: Nota
projects.blurb: Notes and diary app that files your entries for you. Capture by text, voice or image; the model sorts them into categories.

projects.title: LORD AI
projects.blurb: Assistant running Llama 3.3 70B on Groq's LPU, so replies land almost instantly. Ships a music player and zero dependencies.

projects.title: Classic Barber
projects.blurb: Booking app for barber shops with a live queue customers can watch, plus WhatsApp confirmations at every step.

projects.title: Lordlitor
projects.blurb: Mental-arithmetic trainer in the shape of a language app. 21 calculation patterns across 5 categories, difficulty adapts as you go.

projects.title: Top 10
projects.blurb: Real-time football trivia. You and your friends race to name the top ten before anyone else does.

projects.title: NeuroBalance
projects.blurb: Cognitive training experiment — testing whether short daily drills hold attention better than long sessions.
